question: How do caste natures and actions become manifest?
premises: actions are divided by nature-born strands
inference: When concealment ends, each nature manifests and actions are distributed by strands.
uncertainties: fused verb bhavet-tadāha combines optative and quotation
plain_english: When concealment disappears, nature manifests; caste natures necessarily act, and actions are divided by nature-born strands.
